from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792546011/attempts/063d3d0630cb465fa0dfa1151ed4d5f6/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=base/'task-e0193f10.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg:
                continue
            for dc in (-1, 1):
                c2 = c + dc
                if not (0 <= c2 < w) or grid[r + 1][c2] != color:
                    continue
                # The lower end of the diagonal is anchored to the other-color motif.
                if not any(0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] not in (bg, color)
                           for nr, nc in ((r + 1, c2 - 1), (r + 1, c2 + 1),
                                          (r, c2), (r + 2, c2))):
                    continue
                nr, nc = r - 1, c - dc
                while 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and out[nr][nc] == bg:
                    out[nr][nc] = color
                    nr -= 1
                    nc -= dc
    return out
'''
path.write_text(source)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task_e0193f10', path)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def sparse(h,w,bg, cells):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for (r,c),v in cells.items(): g[r][c]=v
    return g
# demo 1: expected added 8s at r4c26 through r9c21

E1=sparse(14,27,9,{(10,20):8,(11,18):0,(11,19):8,(12,18):0,(12,19):8,(13,20):8,**{(r,30-r):8 for r in range(4,10)}})
# demo2: the 2x2 is unchanged
D2=sparse(6,12,8,{(0,10):0,(0,11):1,(1,10):6,(1,11):9})
# demo3: added 3 at (6,0),(7,1)
D3=sparse(11,17,9,{(8,2):3,(9,3):3,(9,4):0,(10,3):1,(10,4):1})
E3=sparse(11,17,9,{(6,0):3,(7,1):3,(8,2):3,(9,3):3,(9,4):0,(10,3):1,(10,4):1})
print('demo matches', O1==E1, mod.transform(D2)==D2, mod.transform(D3)==E3)
T=sparse(10,25,8,{(0,9):3,(0,10):1,(1,9):2,(1,10):5})
print('test unchanged?',mod.transform(T)==T)
print('saved',path)
